newsitem.title: USA: U of Mich consumer sentiment 102.8 Aug preliminary.
newsitem.headline: U of Mich consumer sentiment 102.8 Aug preliminary.

text.p: The University of Michigan's preliminary index of consumer sentiment for August fell to 102.8 against a 107.1 reading in the final July report, financial market sources said on Friday.
The current conditions component fell to 109.3 in the August preliminary survey from 114.0 in the final July.
The consumer expectations index fell to 98.5 in the August preliminary report against 102.6 in final July, the sources said.
The data are released only to paying subscribers.
